cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID. Two reports of the same official a week apart disagree: about 3 million hold the card (Diffa, September 2026) or about 3 million lack one (Agadez, August 2026).
cells.note: The newest fact stands: the September 2026 Diffa report puts holders at about 3 million, about 11% of the population. The earlier Agadez report would give about 36%, so the cell is staged on the lower, later reading.
